title: Review: the common rejections, the appeal, and how long it takes

videos.script:
Every release you send to a store is read by somebody before anybody can install it. {{review}} At Apple, a person opens the app. At Google, a mix of automated checks and people. Either can say no.

Most rejections are not about rules people disagree with. {{reasons}} The reviewer could not sign in. The app crashed. The screenshots showed a login page. Each of those is a day lost, and each could have been caught on your desk.

So today you write a gate. {{gate}} One script that runs the checks from the last lessons, plus a few about the build itself, and says go or stop before you press submit.

And when a rejection comes anyway, {{appeal}} you will know how to read it, answer it, and when an appeal is the right reply.
